text: Seven years after his wife Ryoko dies, widower Shigeharu Aoyama lets his producer friend stage [a fake casting call|wrong|broken trust] so he can meet a new wife. He is [instantly enchanted|trigger|love and desire] by Asami, a quiet former ballerina whose references all lead nowhere. She sits motionless beside her phone for days waiting for him to ring, and in her bare apartment a large sack moves. The [burn scars she carries from childhood|origin|harm done in childhood] hint at why she demands that he [love only her|wants|a lover to possess].
